essence: An auspicious rosary may be fashioned in either a cow-tail-like or serpent-like form.
While fashioning each mātṛkā syllable at the start of stringing, one should recite accordingly.
The practitioner may choose between these two forms according to preference.
After making the rosary, one should purify it.
The rosary should be purified with water using the sadyojāta mantra.
